title: ComboStub
description: Soft HOLD combo stub: bank Who / Why / What worked (and optional failure + next prep) without Notion. Docs-only; not part of the showstack site index.

id.description: Stable slug for this stub row (e.g. t507-greninja-interop-preflight).

date.description: When the combo was captured (ISO 8601 date).

status.description: stub = Soft HOLD banked row; live = promoted outside this schema (Door required).

who.description: Who — seat or owner (role + handle ok).

why.description: Why — context or trigger that made this combo worth keeping.

what_worked.description: What worked — the reversible move or pattern to reuse.

what_failed.description: Optional — what did not work or was rolled back.

next_prep.description: Optional — next reversible prep before the next attempt.

soft_hold.description: Soft HOLD policy flags for this row (Keep-20 · no publish face · no Stripe · M never Notion).

keep_20.description: Keep at most ~20 active stubs per seat; archive or promote via Door.

publish_face.description: Must remain false for stubs in this PR path.

stripe.description: No billing hooks on stub rows.

m_never_notion.description: M seat does not use Notion for combo banking; use file/git paths instead.
